title: High CPU usage in load-generator pod triggers alert
problem: The load-generator pod is consuming very high CPU (6 to 10 cores) causing the container-cpu-high-rate alert to fire. This pod has also experienced multiple restarts due to OOMKilled errors, indicating resource exhaustion issues. Other pods show normal CPU usage. The exact cause of the high CPU consumption is not confirmed without current pod logs.
remediations: Investigate the load-generator pod to understand the cause of high CPU usage
Review application workload and load testing parameters executed by the pod
Tune the load-generator workload or increase CPU resource requests/limits
Monitor pod logs for unusual errors or activities driving CPU usage
Address any issues causing pod restarts or resource exhaustion
Continue monitoring CPU usage trends after applying fixes to ensure normalization
raw_diagnosis:
Report:

Probable Root Cause:
- The alert "container-cpu-high-rate" is firing for the "otel-demo" namespace, indicating high CPU usage in one or more containers.
- The Prometheus metrics for container CPU usage (container_cpu_usage_seconds_total) show that most pods have low CPU usage rates below 0.1 CPU cores.
- However, the pod "load-generator-5765f7695c-tbstm" is consuming very high CPU, with rates around 6 to 10 CPU cores over the last 10 minutes.
- Pod diagnostics for "load-generator-5765f7695c-tbstm" show it is running but has experienced 4 restarts with previous termination reason "OOMKilled" (out-of-memory).
- Another pod "product-catalog-75ff87cdfd-nn8lq" has a single restart with previous error exit but is running fine currently.
- The high CPU usage in the load-generator pod is the likely cause of the firing alert.

Suggested Remediation Steps:
- Investigate the load-generator pod/container to understand why it is using very high CPU.
- Check the application workload or load test parameters it is executing.
- Consider tuning the load-generator to reduce CPU usage or increase its resource allocation (CPU requests/limits).
- Monitor pod logs for any unusual errors or activity causing high CPU.
- Address any underlying issues causing pod restarts or resource exhaustion which may indirectly impact CPU usage.
- Continue observing CPU usage trends after any corrective actions to confirm normalization.

Remaining Uncertainty:
- Without current logs from the load-generator pod, the exact reason for high CPU consumption is unclear.
- No errors or warning events are currently reported on the pods, so further log analysis is recommended for deeper diagnosis.

This concludes the diagnosis based on available pod status, metrics, and alert context.
